items.title: Payop Unveils New Brand Identity at Gamescom - Games Press
items.raw_summary: A simple concept of "payments should never interrupt the game" will be front and centre at this year's show.
items.title_pt: Payop Unveils New Brand Identity at Gamescom
items.summary_pt: Fintech de pagamentos repositiona marca com conceito claro: "pagamentos nunca devem interromper o jogo".
items.pme_pt: Pequenas fintechs aprendem que posicionamento forte (uma frase-essência clara) comunica valor melhor que lista de features.
items.link_kelly: Projeto — exemplo internacional de reposicionamento B2B com essência clara e diferenciada.

items.title: Netcore rebrands to Netcore.ai as it adopts agentic marketing platform - Social Samosa
items.raw_summary: Netcore’s seven AI agents will work with MarTech growth engineers responsible for client outcomes. The agents will plan, execute, analyse and optimise campaigns across the customer lifecycle.
items.title_pt: Netcore se rebranda para Netcore.ai com plataforma de marketing agentic
items.summary_pt: Rebranding alinhado a evolução tecnológica da empresa — nome reflete proposta de valor.
items.pme_pt: Caso prático de como essência (automação inteligente) traduz em identidade verbal — ótimo para aprender com exemplo real no próprio ritmo.

items.title: Tourism fund mulls AI training for start-ups - Jamaica Gleaner
items.raw_summary: The Tourism Enhancement Fund (TEF) wants start-ups in its incubator programme to begin using artificial intelligence (AI) to design prototypes, which could improve their branding, product, and spaces. “The TEF is contemplating the creation of an AI Prototype Development Training Programme for participants in the Tourism Innovation Incubator Challenge,” the agency said in a request for information issued last week.
items.title_pt: Tourism fund mulls AI training for start-ups
items.summary_pt: Fundo de turismo planeja programa de treinamento em IA para startups melhorarem branding, produto e espaços.
